description: The file contains CMake functions, macros, and scripts for managing build configurations, target dependencies, and package installation processes within a CMake-based build system.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Macro to append an element to a list variable in CMake.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Function to derive a default link name and location from a library path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Function to determine the linked libraries and directories for a given target.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Function to retrieve all compile definitions relevant to a target, including interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Function to collect compile options for a target and its dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Function to gather include directories for a target, resolving interface and install interface includes.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Function to generate and install CMake package configuration files for a target.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Function to generate and install pkg-config (.pc) files for a target.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Function to install find modules (.cmake files) recursively or specified files.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Utility to print CMake property list.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Utility to print all properties for a specific target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Replaces semicolons in a string with ASCII 31 character for safe storage.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Function to install a compatible CMake configuration target, including public headers and dependencies.
